objective_notes: Germany have no confirmed absences, with only Manuel Neuer listed as a fitness doubt; Wirtz, Musiala and Havertz are expected attacking starters. | Curacao report no major injuries, but this is their World Cup debut against a much deeper Germany squad. | Houston afternoon heat and thunderstorm risk are partly mitigated by stadium conditions, so the weather effect is kept modest.

Netherlands have enough chance creation but enter with a negative build-up narrative and must convert better than in recent friendlies. | Japan are missing Wataru Endo and Kaoru Mitoma, but their collective form remains strong after six straight wins and major friendly wins. | Dallas indoor/covered-stadium conditions reduce weather impact, so the adjustment mostly comes from squad and form factors.

Ivory Coast were unbeaten in qualifying and did not concede in CAF qualifying, with strong recent form entering the tournament. | Ecuador had the strongest CONMEBOL qualifying defence, conceding only five goals in 18 matches, and are unbeaten in 19 matches. | Philadelphia evening thunderstorm risk slightly lowers tempo and increases draw or one-goal-margin outcomes.
